name: Naro Space Center
best_known_for: South Korea's spaceport: Naro-1 (2009-13) and the home-built Nuri rocket since 2021
credit: South Korea's launch site on the coast of Goheung County, run by the Korea Aerospace Research Institute, with two pads, LC-1 and LC-2. The first Naro-1 flight on 25 August 2009 failed to reach orbit; Nuri reached orbit on 21 June 2022. Facts from Wikipedia (Naro Space Center, Naro-1, Nuri); coordinates are the Wikipedia site point, between LC-1 and LC-2.
